verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a local model runner, but the evidence pack documents no export feature that would let a user move models, chats, or settings out in open formats. Data locality claims (prompts not tracked, local data stays on the machine) are adjacent privacy features, not export. A community comment alleges lock-in through a proprietary registry format with hashed filenames, which further undercuts any portability claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
